symbol: Ctrl zoom keys and Ctrl wheel
proposed_value: Keys: `cx.intercept_keystrokes` on the root view (A5); Ctrl+up/+/=/numpad+ zoom in, Ctrl+down/-/_/numpad- zoom out, Ctrl+0 resets; ignore with Alt or Win; return early during IME composition; `cx.stop_propagation()` when handled. Wheel: window-level `on_mouse_event::<ScrollWheelEvent>` in the capture phase, `cx.stop_propagation()` with Ctrl. Convert `ScrollDelta::Lines(l)` to Chromium pixels: `px = -l x 100/3 / (zoom / 100)`; `Pixels(p)` -> `-p / (zoom / 100)` (RULEBOOK §2 wheel row). Accumulate, reset on a sign change, step once at +/-40, clear after 180 ms (`wheel_reset: Option<Task<()>>`).
proposed_status: settled (Step 2 spike final1-2; Chromium source and headless zoom baseline).
